after5_start.name: {name}
after5_start.text: *The event is winding down. I naturally run into the two I didn't choose.*

after5_farewell_seo_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_1.text: *I run into Seoyeon in the hallway.*

after5_farewell_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_4.text: Well, I knew. You never did what I expected from the start.

after5_farewell_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_6.text: Next time, I'll be the one to take you.

after5_farewell_seo_7.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_7.text: *Seoyeon turns and waves. The same gesture as Day 1. She doesn't look back. Her back is straight. Perfectly. But this time, she isn't trembling.*

after5_farewell_yuna_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_1.text: *Yuna approaches in front of the library. Without a word, she hands me a book.*

after5_farewell_yuna_2.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_2.text: *A bookmark is tucked inside. A single line on the bookmark.*

after5_farewell_yuna_3.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_3.text: *'It was fun. ...See you in the next story.'*

after5_farewell_yuna_5.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_5.text: *Yuna's 'It was fun' is a word that compresses everything an ordinary person would say — 'Thank you, I liked you, let's meet again.'*

after5_farewell_dain_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_1.text: *Dain comes running from in front of the gym.*

after5_farewell_dain_4.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_4.text: But hey, it's your choice. Next time you better give me a chance too!

after5_farewell_dain_5.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_5.text: *She grins and punches my shoulder with her fist. Same force as Day 1. The exclamation marks are alive and well. Dain is Dain to the very end. That's her strength.*

after5_hidden_farewell_1.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_1.text: *In front of the school gate. I can see three figures in the distance. Seoyeon walking with Haeun, Dain tossing a volleyball as she runs, Yuna reading a book as she walks slowly.*

after5_hidden_farewell_2.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_2.text: *None of them look this way. — That's how it should be. I chose someone else.*

after5_hidden_farewell_3.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_3.text: *I won't say I'm sorry. Those words — saying them to those people would only be cruel. Just silently, in my heart. Thank you.*

after5_sunset_1.name: {name}
after5_sunset_1.text: *The sun is setting. Five days are coming to an end.*

after5_end.name: {name}
after5_end.text: *The sunset paints the schoolyard. Were five days really this short? — The moment of the final choice draws near.*

after5_last_chance_1.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_1.text: *My feet stop. The setting sun casts a long shadow behind me.*

after5_last_chance_2.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2.text: *At my old school, it was the same. I couldn't say it. And I regretted it. — Am I going to do this again?*

after5_last_chance_choice.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_choice.text: *If not now, I'll never be able to say it.*

after5_confess_yes.name: {name}
after5_confess_yes.text: *I turn around. My voice trembles. — But this time.*

after5_confess_yes_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_yes_2.text: Hey — I have something to tell you.

after5_confess_react_seo.name: Seoyeon
after5_confess_react_seo.text: *Walking side by side.* ...You're late. But — not too late.

after5_confess_react_dain.name: Dain
after5_confess_react_dain.text: *Leaving the school.* Wait, for real?! ...For real?

after5_confess_react_yuna.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna.text: *We walked side by side.* ...I already knew.

after5_confess_no.name: {name}
after5_confess_no.text: *My lips won't move. Again. — Again, I couldn't say it.*

after5_confess_no_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_no_2.text: *The evening breeze blows in. The shadow behind me grows longer. — I'm alone.*

after5_hidden_farewell_3b.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_3b.text: *I walked to the back of the school.*

after5_farewell_dain_5b.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_5b.text: *I left the gym and headed to the back of the school.*

after5_farewell_seo_6_ins.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_6_ins.text: *Seoyeon turns and waves. — The same gesture as Day 1. She doesn't look back.*

after5_farewell_seo_6_ins2.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_6_ins2.text: *Her back is straight. Perfectly. — But this time, she isn't trembling.*

after5_farewell_dain_4_ins.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_4_ins.text: *She grins and punches my shoulder with her fist. — Same force as Day 1.*

after5_farewell_dain_4_ins3.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_4_ins3.text: *The exclamation marks are alive and well. — Dain is Dain to the very end. That's her strength.*

after5_farewell_dain_4_ins4.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_4_ins4.text: *Only appears when there's a route but the formal confession hasn't been accepted or rejected.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins.text: *I almost ran away again. Just like at my old school. Phone in my pocket, unable to say a word — that moment nearly came back. — No. Not this time.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins2.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins2.text: *My legs move. My mouth opens first. No prepared words. — My body just moves on its own.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins4.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins4.text: *Seoyeon turns around. The sunset at her back.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins6.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins6.text: *A moment of silence. The wind blows her hair. She doesn't brush it aside.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins7.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_2_ins7.text: But — not too late. Because you came back instead of running.

after5_last_chance_2_ins8.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins8.text: *She holds out her pinky. The same finger I couldn't take on Day 4.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins10.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins10.text: *Walking side by side — we leave the school behind.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins14.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins14.text: *Her eyes go wide. One second. Two seconds.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins16.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins16.text: *The exclamation marks disappear. Her voice gets small. — Her eyes are filling up.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins17.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_ins17.text: I — I've been waiting. Since yesterday. No, since the day before.

after5_last_chance_2_ins18.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_ins18.text: *She rubs her eyes with her fist. Laughing and crying at the same time.*

after5_last_chance_2_ins19.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_ins19.text: Ugh why are you crying — this is supposed to be happy —

after5_confess_react_yuna_ins.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_ins.text: *Yuna sets down her book. Her expression doesn't change. — But her hands are trembling.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_ins3.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_ins3.text: *She hands me a note. Folded paper. One line when unfolded.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_ins5.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_ins5.text: *One line, but the ink is smeared. — She was crying as she wrote it.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_ins7.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_ins7.text: *We walked side by side. In silence.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_ins8.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_ins8.text: *Directly tied to the protagonist's core arc: A person who couldn't speak is trying to speak without regrets this time. This choice is the final test of that theme. — And there was someone who waited.*
